descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
A horror arcade where players build their own claustrophobic levels. Create your personal nightmare in seconds with the built-in editor, or dive into the default levels.

The action unfolds inside a dark, cramped labyrinth of towering walls linked by ladders across multiple vertical floors. Dim lighting, unsettling sound, and constant pursuit make every corner feel dangerous.

Dig through the ground to trap your pursuers, climb to escape them, and grab every skull scattered through the maze. Once the last skull is collected, a hidden exit appears somewhere in the labyrinth. Find it before the enemies find you — because they want their skulls back.

Features:
- Build your own levels in a fast, intuitive VR editor
- Multiple ready-made levels to play right away
- Vertical labyrinths with ladders, bars, and diggable floors
- Trap enemies by collapsing the ground beneath them
- Atmospheric horror: dim light, tense sound, and relentless pursuit
